title: Chart the Invisible: Interactive Perception for Hidden-Target Exploration in GUI Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.35237v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Despite rapid progress in command-line interface (CLI) tasks, recent LLM-based agents still struggle with reliable task execution through graphical user interfaces (GUIs). A key challenge is the limited content visible within a bounded viewport, especially on mobile devices, where many task-relevant targets remain hidden and can only be revealed through swipe interactions. Therefore, although most GUI agents support swipe as an action primitive, the lack of target visibility makes it difficult for them to decide when, where, and how to swipe to reveal the hidden content. Our quantitative study further shows that GUI agents incorrectly choose a click action in 47.8% of cases that require swipe exploration. To bridge this gap, this paper proposes equipping GUI agents with scrollable-region perception to support hidden-area exploration before action selection. translated_title: 绘制不可见之物：面向GUI智能体隐藏目标探索的交互式感知
translated_abstract: 尽管在命令行界面（CLI）任务方面取得了快速进展，但近期基于大语言模型的智能体在通过图形用户界面（GUI）可靠执行任务方面仍然存在困难。一个关键挑战是有限视口内可见内容的局限性，尤其是在移动设备上，许多与任务相关的目标处于隐藏状态，只能通过滑动交互才能显现。因此，尽管大多数GUI智能体支持将滑动作为动作原语，但由于缺乏目标可见性，它们难以决定何时、何地以及如何滑动以显示隐藏内容。我们的定量研究进一步表明，在需要滑动探索的情形中，GUI智能体在47.8%的情况下错误地选择了点击操作。为弥合这一差距，本文提出为GUI智能体配备可滚动区域感知能力，以支持在动作选择之前进行隐藏区域探索。为此，我们训练了首个用于可滚动区域感知的多模态模型……
tldr: 该论文提出了首个用于可滚动区域感知的多模态模型，使GUI智能体能够在动作选择前探索隐藏区域，从而解决智能体在面对视口外隐藏目标时难以决定何时、何地及如何滑动的关键难题。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the first multimodal model for scrollable-region perception, enabling GUI agents to explore hidden areas before action selection and addressing the challenge of deciding when, where, and how to swipe to reveal hidden targets within bounded viewports.
